distance_semantics.endpoint_basis: approximate optical component center or reflection point as described by source; not principal planes, housing surfaces, or sensor plane calibration

unknown_reasons.mechanical_gap_mm: No housing-face measurements or reproducible mechanical datum; source endpoints refer to approximate optical centers/reflection points.
unknown_reasons.principal_plane_gap_mm: Lens model/installed orientation and principal-plane locations are not established by the photo estimates.
unknown_reasons.geometric_path_mm: Folded beam axes and reflection angles are not calibrated; straight-line endpoint projections are not a verified ray path.
unknown_reasons.optical_path_length_mm: In-element propagation lengths and refractive indices along the actual path are unknown.
